To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we introduce a new open-source framework, GEOPM, that enables the HPC community and vendors to collaborate in the development of new energy management software.

we introduce a runtime framework for HPC energy management that is extensible, open source, and hierarchical, and that we demonstrate the potential of this framework by prototyping a power rebalancing example plugin.

we introduce the Global-Extensible Open Power Manager as a vehicle for HPC community collaboration on co-designed energy management strategies and demonstrate the framework's potential by developing an example power rebalancing algorithm that improves the time-to-solutions of HPC workloads.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) the design and implementation of a hierarchical framework for power management, (2) the design and development of a power management plugin for GEOPMs, and (3) the evaluation of the power management plugin using CORAL system benchmarks.
the design and evaluation of a runtime framework to foster collaboration and accelerate progress toward software-harwdare co-designed energy management.
enabling a new era of software-hardware co-design for energy management in the HPC community.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
GEOPM is a framework to facilitate rapid prototyping and deployment of new energy management policies for HPC systems.
the GEOPM framework is an important step forward in the development of co-designed energy management strategies.
the Global Extensible Power Manager (GEOM) is a new open-source framework for power management in high-performance computing systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GEOPM framework is a vehicle for the HPC community collaboration on co-designed energy management solution.

the GEOPM framework is an open source runtime framework that can be used by the HPC community in order to develop and test new energy management strategies and improve performance and/or energy efficiency of HPC centers.
GEOPM is an open source, extensible, hierarchical runtime framework that enables rapid prototyping and testing of new energy management techniques and strategies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the community can benefit from the open collaboration facilitated by GEOPM to develop co-designed energy management strategies for Exascale systems and beyond.
GEOPM provides a vehicle for HPC community collaboration and software-hardware co-design of energy management solutions.
the GEOPM framework is a powerful tool for HPC centers to collaborate and accelerate the development of energy management strategies.
